(* ---- Classical helpers for the period recovery (shor_general_success) ---- *)

lemma sg_bounds1: "2 * \<bar>y\<bar> \<le> (r::int) \<Longrightarrow> - r \<le> 2 * y"
proof -
  assume h: "2 * \<bar>y\<bar> \<le> r"
  have "- y \<le> \<bar>y\<bar>" by (rule abs_ge_minus_self)
  thus ?thesis using h by linarith
qed

lemma sg_bounds2: "2 * \<bar>y\<bar> \<le> (r::int) \<Longrightarrow> 2 * y \<le> r"
proof -
  assume h: "2 * \<bar>y\<bar> \<le> r"
  have "y \<le> \<bar>y\<bar>" by (rule le_abs_self)
  thus ?thesis using h by linarith
qed

(* the least denominator of a fraction within 1/(2N) of j/N (`recover`) is the period r *)
lemma sg_recover_period:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and cop: "coprime c r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "recover N j = r"
proof -
  have hr0: "(0::int) \<le> int r" by simp
  have hb0': "(0::int) \<le> int b" if "0 < b" for b :: nat using that by simp
  have rr': "int r * int r < int N" using rr by (metis of_nat_mult of_nat_less_iff)
  have rN: "int r < int N"
  proof -
    have "r \<le> r * r" by (rule Nat.le_mul_self)
    thus ?thesis using rr' r by (metis of_nat_le_iff of_nat_mult of_nat_less_iff le_less_trans
      less_le_trans nat_less_le)
  qed
  unfolding recover_def
  proof (rule Least_equality)
    show "0 < r \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int r - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int r)"
      using r near by auto
  next
    fix b :: nat
    assume hb: "0 < b \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b)"
    then obtain a where hb0: "0 < b" and ha: "2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b"
      by blast
    show "r \<le> b"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> r \<le> b"
      then have hbr: "b < r" by simp
      have hb0R: "(0::int) \<le> int b" by simp
      define X where "X = int j * int b - a * int N"
      define Y where "Y = int j * int r - int c * int N"
      have key: "int r * X - int b * Y = int N * (int b * int c - a * int r)"
        unfolding X_def Y_def by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have hX1: "- int b \<le> 2 * X" using sg_bounds1[of "int b" X] ha by (simp add: X_def)
      have hX2: "2 * X \<le> int b" using sg_bounds2[of "int b" X] ha by (simp add: X_def)
      have hY1: "- int r \<le> 2 * Y" using sg_bounds1[of "int r" Y] near by (simp add: Y_def)
      have hY2: "2 * Y \<le> int r" using sg_bounds2[of "int r" Y] near by (simp add: Y_def)
      have m1: "int r * (2 * X) \<le> int r * int b" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hX2 hr0])
      have m2: "int r * (- int b) \<le> int r * (2 * X)" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hX1 hr0])
      have m3: "int b * (2 * Y) \<le> int b * int r" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hY2 hb0R])
      have m4: "int b * (- int r) \<le> int b * (2 * Y)" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hY1 hb0R])
      have hT: "\<bar>int N * (int b * int c - a * int r)\<bar> \<le> int r * int b"
      proof -
        have "int N * (int b * int c - a * int r) \<le> int r * int b"
          using key m1 m4 by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
        moreover have "- (int r * int b) \<le> int N * (int b * int c - a * int r)"
          using key m2 m3 by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
        ultimately show ?thesis by simp
      qed
      have hlt: "int r * int b < int N"
      proof -
        have "int r * int b \<le> int r * int r" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF _ hr0]) (use hbr in simp)
        thus ?thesis using rr' by linarith
      qed
      have hN0: "(0::int) < int N" using rN hr0 by linarith
      have T1: "int b * int c - a * int r < 1"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume "\<not> (int b * int c - a * int r < 1)"
        then have "1 \<le> int b * int c - a * int r" by simp
        from mult_left_mono[OF this hN0.le] have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * (int b * int c - a * int r)" .
        thus False using hT hlt by (simp add: abs_le_iff) linarith
      qed
      have T2: "-1 < int b * int c - a * int r"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume "\<not> (-1 < int b * int c - a * int r)"
        then have "int b * int c - a * int r \<le> -1" by simp
        from mult_left_mono[OF this hN0.le] have "int N * (int b * int c - a * int r) \<le> int N * (-1)" .
        thus False using hT hlt by (simp add: abs_le_iff) linarith
      qed
      have zero_of_small: "\<forall>t::int. -1 < t \<longrightarrow> t < 1 \<longrightarrow> t = 0" by (intro allI impI) simp
      have T0: "int b * int c - a * int r = 0"
        using zero_of_small T1 T2 by (meson)
      have heq: "int b * int c = a * int r" using T0 by linarith
      have dvd_int: "int r dvd int b * int c" using heq by (simp add: mult.commute)
      have dvd_nat: "r dvd b * c"
        using dvd_int by (metis of_nat_mult int_dvd_int_iff)
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have rdvd_b: "r dvd b" using cop' dvd_nat by (rule coprime_dvd_mul_right_nat)
      have "r \<le> b" using rdvd_b hb0 by (rule Nat.dvd_imp_le)
      thus False using hbr by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

end
